cite: agents.md §1 TACO objects, not DOM calls; northstar — TACO is the UI primitive
description: App UI built with document.querySelector / getElementById / createElement / innerHTML instead of bw.DOM / bw.mount / bw.create / TACO trees.
goodHint: bw.DOM('#app', taco); bw.mount('#app', taco); update via el.bw handles or bw.refresh

cite: agents.md §4 Events in attributes, not addEventListener
description: Interactive handlers attached with addEventListener inside o.mounted (lost on re-render).
goodHint: { t: 'button', a: { onclick: fn }, c: 'Save' } or bw.makeButton({ onclick: fn })

cite: agents.md §3 CSS from palette; northstar Quick drift — hardcoding hex
description: Theme-role colors (surfaces, borders, text, accents) hardcoded as hex/rgb instead of styles.palette / styles.layout tokens from loadStyles/makeStyles.
badHint: background: '#f5f5f5'; color: '#333'; injectCSS with literal hex for theme roles
goodHint: var p = styles.palette; background: p.surfaceAlt; color: p.dark.base; spacing from styles.layout

cite: agents.md §3 — bitwrench does not use var(--bw_*) as the design-system path
description: Teaching or using var(--bw_*) / var(--bw-*) as the primary theming path instead of palette objects.
goodHint: background: p.surface; color: p.primary.base from styles.palette

description: Hand-built table, modal, navbar, tabs, toast, form controls, etc. when a bw.make* BCCL component exists.
badHint: Hand-rolled { t: 'table', ... } or custom modal overlay TACO

cite: agents.md — Components own their DOM; handles/slots for targeted updates
description: Full remount / full-page rebuild / bw.DOM wipe where el.bw handles, slots, bw.patch, or bw.refresh on a small stateful root would fit.
badHint: Every click rebuilds the entire page via bw.DOM('#app', ...)
goodHint: el.bw.setTitle(...); slots; bw.refresh(statefulRoot) for local state

cite: agents.md §5 Explicit state, not hand-coded reactivity
description: Outer mutable variables + manual DOM sync mimicking React/jQuery reactivity instead of o.state + bw.refresh, handles, or bw.pub/sub.
badHint: var count = 0; function render() { el.textContent = count; }
goodHint: o.state + o.render + bw.refresh; or el.bw.handle methods

cite: northstar — shared tokens; BCCL visual language
description: One-off styling that ignores shared palette/layout tokens and looks inconsistent with BCCL (ad-hoc radii, spacing, type) without a documented demo reason.
badHint: Random magic spacing/colors unrelated to styles.layout / palette
goodHint: Use styles.layout spacing/radius/typeScale and palette roles
